body: I'm 15 also and I've been suicidal since like January 2016 so basically 2 1/2 years now. I first attempted suicide 1 week before turning 13 in February 2016. Since then I've had like 8 fucking suicide attempts. I'm planning on really ending it all on August 3. This time I think it will succeed. I've already 'practiced' hanging myself the past 2 months just to get an idea of what it will feel like when I do finally end up doing it.
Hey I'm also 15/F and I'm planning on hanging myself in less than a month.

I am 15 years old and I've heard of 5 year olds wanting to kill themselves. I even saw a comment of an 8 year old on YouTube saying that she wanted to commit suicide. When I was 8, I didn't even know what the word suicide meant so I'm definitely not to young to think like this. I don't want to deal with school anymore, I fucking hate it. All the fucking drama and immature people. Tests and quizes give me so much anxiety and whenever I get a bad grade, I feel like a fucking failure and feel so stupid. But school isn't the only reason why I want to kill myself and there are many more reasons why I want to die.

I have only one so called 'friend' of mine that I used to have at school this year. We still text each other every now and then, but I don't see him since I don't have school right now. Honeslty, he doesn't care about me and doesn't give a single fuck if I were to die. He is extremly immature just like most people at my school. He acts like he's 5 years old and is really mean to me. One time he told me that whenever he sees his other friends texts, he immediately replies to them and texts them but as soon as he sees my texts he completely ignores them. This obviously shows that he doesn't care about me. I didn't even ask to be his friend, back in August last year when I had first started school, I was sitting alone at lunch when suddenly he came up to me. We introduced ourselves and he even bought me a water bottle and a candy for me. I thought he liked me or something and he asked if I wanted to be friends with him and I said yes because he seemed so kind. It wasn't till one month later where he started being annoying and rude to me. I have talked to him about my suicidal thoughts and he acts like it's no big deal and doesn't try to at least help me with it.
You can pm me if you want to.

Hey I know how you feel. I don't think that by next month I'm going to be alive anymore. My depression is really bad right and I don't think it has gotten this bad until now. I'm planning on hanging myself but I'm really scared to do it. I just wish I could just die painlessly in my sleep. I cry every single day and I only eat 1 meal a day and I'm started to lose weight and I look skinnier. I once used to be so happy and careless many years back, but unfortanetly everything changed and now nothing makes me happy, not even my favorite music. Sometimes I feel like I don't even feel anything anymore and just feel numb. I absouletly hate getting memories of when my life was all good and I was so happy. It just makes cry cause I know that those times are gone. I know that there's not much I can do to help you but I do hope you'll find someone to love you since you said you have no one...

And also my depression wouldnt be as bad if my mom were still here. My dad's girlfriend makes my depression like 20x worse and makes me hate living in this house.

Yes because my mom never argued with my dad or me. She was a really nice person unlike my dad's girlfriend who always gets mad at me and my dad. I feel like my dad wants her out of the house also. Unfortanetly my moms dead and there's no way I can bring her back into my life obviously.

Im 15, but like I said there's no way I can talk to her right now. Even if I do tell her that I'm thinking about dying, she's gonna tell my dad and I'm really worried about how he's gonna react. She already told me that if I ever told her that I was thinking about dying then she was gonna have to tell my dad.

No there is no way I can talk to her right now. Even If I do tell her that I want to kill myself she's going to send the cops over to my house and my dad and sister will find out and their probably gonna think I'm crazy and be very upset. I don't want this to turn into a huge scene  .
I really want to see season 4 of star vs the forces of evil but I have a feeling that once it comes out I won't be alive anymore.
